title: Puppet Master Shared Integration Runtime contracts
description: Closed pre-build shared-runtime value envelopes. These schemas define durable data and transition invariants only; they do not implement handlers, confer Event Authority, authorize WorkNodes, or certify runtime behavior.

non_secret_ref.description: Stable non-secret reference. Raw credentials, tokens, auth values, credential paths, file contents, and provider-visible bytes are forbidden.

environment_connection_transition.title: EnvironmentConnectionTransition
environment_connection_transition.description: A pairwise pre-build invariant envelope used to reject supervisor replacement without a generation increase and connection-epoch regression within a supervisor generation.

observable_work_projection.title: ObservableWorkProjection
observable_work_projection.description: Derived redb projection. It is not a canonical event source and never fabricates percent complete.

operational_awareness_projection.title: OperationalAwarenessProjection
operational_awareness_projection.description: Bounded derived redb projection. Raw inventories, logs, catalogs, secrets, and protected AuthBrowserSession details are forbidden.

prompt_runtime_projection.title: PromptRuntimeProjection
prompt_runtime_projection.description: Immutable bounded prompt-consumed snapshot. It excludes raw catalogs, WSL/container inventories, Tool Store contents, credentials, and local paths.

permission_snapshot_record.title: PermissionSnapshotRecord
permission_snapshot_record.description: Permissions-owned immutable attempt evidence materialized here for the shared-runtime join. It is never reconstructed from current Settings, safe points, restore points, or projections.

provider_dispatch_admission_receipt.title: ProviderDispatchAdmissionReceipt
provider_dispatch_admission_receipt.description: The sole durable evidence form of the ephemeral ProviderRequestPermit. It is single-use and retry-specific; it stores a SHA-256 digest and refs, never raw provider request bytes or secrets.

installation_inventory_record.title: InstallationInventoryRecord
installation_inventory_record.description: Bounded BinaryLocator-backed evidence inventory. It grants neither permission nor acquisition authority.

stream_coalescing_record.title: StreamCoalescingRecord
stream_coalescing_record.description: Lossless canonical stream ordering and terminal flush-barrier evidence.

thread_shell_projection.title: ThreadShell
thread_shell_projection.description: Lightweight derived thread-list projection. It is not transcript authority and cannot authorize work.

pinned_summary_projection.title: PinnedSummary
pinned_summary_projection.description: Bounded derived summary for a visibly pinned thread; full transcript and artifacts remain separately fetched.

thread_detail_projection.title: ThreadDetail
thread_detail_projection.description: Focused-thread-only derived transcript/tool/activity projection with explicit replay currentness.

mcp_server_lifecycle_record.title: McpServerLifecycleRecord
mcp_server_lifecycle_record.description: MCP-owned component lifecycle record. The independent component axes must not collapse into one connected Boolean.

operational_attribution_record.title: OperationalAttributionRecord
operational_attribution_record.description: Usage-owned non-model operational timing and lineage. Model calls retain separate immutable Usage records.

environment_domain_sync_transition.title: EnvironmentDomainSyncTransitionValidation
environment_domain_sync_transition.description: Ephemeral transition pair used to reject old-epoch and regressed domain publications.

provider_dispatch_attempt_validation.title: ProviderDispatchAttemptValidation
provider_dispatch_attempt_validation.description: Ephemeral validation envelope for one attempted use of the sole durable ProviderDispatchAdmissionReceipt.

provider_request_permit.title: ProviderRequestPermit
provider_request_permit.description: Ephemeral decision name and non-persisted view of the same logical ProviderDispatchAdmissionReceipt. This is not a second type, identity, receipt, lease, or storage family.
